title: Sarcoidosis-associated Pulmonary Hypertension
brief_summary: This prospective study was conducted to explore clinical characteristics and outcomes of patients diagnosed with pulmonary sarcoidosis and PH. The investigators also assessed the role of D -dimer levels in these population.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All patients above 18 years old

Exclusion Criteria:

* Non sarcoidosis
